metadata.statistical_discipline: Five frozen E checkpoints are independent units; F is a control. Probes are analysis-only, fit on TRAIN, tuned on VAL, tested once on TEST; they never enter model inference.

decision.rule_note: Q-A: linear recoverability >= 0.50 with wrap/repeated same direction. Q-B: linear < 0.50 and nonlinear-linear >= 0.20. Q-C: both weak. Q-MIX: wrap/no-wrap/repeated disagree (spread >= 0.15). Bars are declared conventions.
